_about: Every setting the bot may change about itself. Flat, same key names the docs use. Written by npm run setup; editable from the DM ('raise the ask budget to $15'), which shows the diff; applied live, and only COMMAND_PREFIX and EVENT_POLL_SECONDS restart the bot. Secrets and wiring (keys, tokens, the Elixir URL, the app and server ids) are in .env, not here. Keys starting with _ are notes and ignored.
_channels: Where the bot LISTENS: the ask channel, where members' questions are answered in threads. Where it POSTS is not configured: every channel where its role is explicitly granted Send Messages is in its directory and the model chooses. A routine may name a default with channel:, bound here as CHANNEL_<NAME> or matched by channel name.
_admins: Discord user ids who may use the admin slash commands, DM the bot as its operator, and receive its notices and review proposals. Everything they do costs money, so this is an allow-list. Empty means no DMs go anywhere.
_budgets: Strict, UTC calendar months, per lane, nothing rolls over. A lane refuses to START a turn that could take it past the line, using the largest turn it has ever produced as the estimate. Unset means unlimited, which the boot log warns about.
_ASK_DAILY_TURNS_PER_MEMBER: Questions one member may ask per day, so nobody drains the shared pot; 0 = no cap; admins exempt. Default 20.
_TURN_RESERVE_USD: What one turn is assumed to cost before this install has seen one. Default 0.30.
_DAILY_USD_CAP: An extra ceiling on top of the monthly budgets. Unset means none.
_claude: Your choice of model, for every routine that does not name its own; a routine can override both in its front matter. The model must have a price in agent/models.json or the shipped catalog, or the bot refuses to boot.
_schedule: Schedules in agent/routines/*.md are written in THIS zone (IANA, e.g. America/Chicago); '22:00' means your evening, DST included.
_feed: How often the timeline is read. Every poll is a metered call and the feed is empty most of the time; 1800 is the hub's own advice, 300 posts joins within minutes.
_commands: Three bots on one server each register /run; a prefix keeps them apart (/pk-run).
_review: The review lane: once a week (REVIEW_AT) and on /review the bot reads its own turn ledger, grades what it said, and DMs the admins at most REVIEW_MAX_PROPOSALS proposed edits to agent/ with Apply buttons. Its own model, budget and clock. REVIEW_AUTO_MEMORY lets it write memory.md without a click (never identity.md, never a brief).
_misc: FEEDBACK_CHANNEL: logical channel for Elixir's replies to filed feedback (default: the first event routine's channel, else the first in the directory). MAX_POSTS_PER_TURN: how many post_message calls one routine turn may make (3). STARTUP_MESSAGE: the one-line hello to the admins' DM on boot (on); it never goes to a member channel. ROUTINES_DISABLED: comma-separated keys kept off; a routine's own enabled: false does the same.
_voice: How long the channels the bot posts in may go quiet before timeline items the editor names as carry (badge level-ups, collection steps, card unlocks, quiet crossings) are allowed to start a turn on their own. A wake item (a join, a promotion, a standout session, a resolved week) starts one immediately and takes the carried items with it; VOICE only sets the release for carried items: quiet = never, normal = 12h, chatty = 4h. It is a coalescing interval, not a prompt lean: nothing tells the model how much to say, and a turn that finds nothing worth a post still replies SKIP.
